scenes.name: SC 1 · INT. RAHUL'S HOME · NIGHT
scenes.summary: Rahul comes home wrecked, walks past his parents and drops onto the bed.

shots.action: Rahul enters home exhausted while a radial blur visualises his stress.
Rahul drops his keys into the bowl and places his tiffin on the table.
His parents call from the background while Rahul continues toward his room.
Rahul enters the dark bedroom; the radial blur gradually fades.
Hold on Rahul's face as eerie sounds begin to build.
Rahul falls onto the bed and lets his body go limp.
Match-cut transition from Rahul on the bed into the underwater sequence.

scenes.name: SC 2 · INT. OPEN POOL / UNDERWATER · NIGHT
scenes.summary: Rahul plunges under, panics, and a car horn drags him out of the water.

shots.action: Rahul plunges into the water, disoriented and unaware of his surroundings.
Rahul panics underwater and struggles to understand where he is.
The frame pushes toward Rahul's eyes.
Rahul closes his eyes as a car horn fades in; smash to black.

scenes.name: SC 3 · EXT. DYSTOPIAN CITY / URBAN ROAD · DAY
scenes.summary: Rahul wakes on the road and nobody will know him: strangers, mother, father, a cop.

shots.action: Rahul opens his eyes in the dystopian city as an approaching horn grows louder.
A car nearly reaches Rahul and he rolls out of its path.
Rahul sits up, catches his breath and searches his pockets and clothes.
Rahul asks multiple passersby for help, but each stranger refuses.
The Old Man steps forward and offers Rahul his phone.
Rahul calls Jayaben and says that he is Rahul, her son.
Jayaben refuses to recognise Rahul and disconnects the call.
Rahul calls Kantibhai and explains that he is lost without his phone or wallet.
Kantibhai denies knowing anyone named Rahul and hangs up.
Kantibhai rises from the sofa as part of the father-to-police transition.
Rahul grabs the figure's shoulder; when he turns, the father has become a Police Officer.
Rahul explains that he is lost and has no phone or wallet.
The officer asks Rahul's name and requests identification.
Rahul confirms he has no Aadhaar card, PAN card or licence.
The officer says Rahul must bring proof before they can speak further, then leaves.
Montage: Rahul searches for information about who he is and where he is.
Rahul screams in frustration, asking someone to give him an answer.
The frame pulls away and leaves Rahul isolated in the city.

scenes.name: SC 4 · EXT./INT. ROADSIDE DHABA → HIGHWAY · LATE NIGHT
scenes.summary: Rahul begs a lift at a dhaba, then rides truck to bike to car into Ahmedabad at dawn.

shots.action: Rahul drinks water at the dhaba, visibly exhausted and distressed.
A rough, stressed Rahul takes in the dhaba surroundings.
Rahul asks a truck driver for a lift and the driver agrees.
Rahul begins the journey in the truck.
Locked-position travel transition changes Rahul's ride from truck to bike.
The travel transition changes again from bike to car.
The car enters Ahmedabad as a doorbell sound begins the transition to Rahul's home.

scenes.name: SC 5 · EXT./INT. OUTSIDE RAHUL'S HOME · MORNING
scenes.summary: Rahul rings his own doorbell; parents and neighbours deny him and the door shuts.

shots.action: Rahul rings the doorbell from his point of view.
Jayaben opens the door while Kantibhai is visible in the background.
Rahul calls out to Kantibhai and insists that this is his home.
Jayaben rejects Rahul and refers to the earlier phone calls.
Rahul tries to enter and asks what proof he can give to establish his identity.
Rahul recalls the orange wall, Kantibhai's medicine routine and the radio gift.
Kantibhai stands and approaches Rahul.
Neighbours gather around the house after hearing the confrontation.
A neighbour asks Kantibhai what has happened.
Kantibhai asks whether the neighbour recognises Rahul.
The neighbour denies recognising Rahul.
Kantibhai threatens to call the police and shuts the door.
The neighbours close in and pressure Rahul to leave; he exits the area.

scenes.name: SC 6 · EXT./INT. OUTSIDE JAIMIN'S HOME · MORNING
scenes.summary: Jaimin does not know him either; the door slams and Rahul runs through the city.

shots.action: Rahul knocks heavily on Jaimin's door.
Jaimin opens the door and sees Rahul outside.
Rahul pleads with Jaimin to say that he recognises him.
Jaimin denies knowing Rahul and assumes he may be selling something.
Jaimin shuts the door hard in Rahul's face.
Montage: Rahul runs through multiple locations while people eating nearby observe him.

scenes.name: SC 7 · INT. BANK INTERIOR · DAY
scenes.summary: The bank asks for PAN then Aadhaar; Rahul has neither and walks out.

shots.action: Rahul enters the bank and approaches the bank representative for help.
Rahul says he has an account and wants to withdraw money.
The bank representative asks for Rahul's registered phone number.
The bank representative requests Rahul's PAN card; Rahul says he does not have it.
The bank representative asks for Aadhaar; Rahul again says he does not have it.
Hold on Rahul's expression before he leaves the bank.

scenes.name: SC 8 · INT. WHITE VOID / CYCLORAMA · OUT OF TIME
scenes.summary: Rahul steps into an endless white void ringed with doors that shut one by one.

shots.action: From Rahul's point of view, he steps into an endless white void.
Multiple doors surround Rahul inside the white space.
The doors shut one by one around Rahul.

scenes.name: SC 9 · INT. RAHUL'S BEDROOM · SUNRISE
scenes.summary: Rahul wakes for real; Jayaben shuts the balcony door and tidies his documents.

shots.action: Rahul's eyes open from his point of view as he returns to reality.
Jayaben closes the balcony door in Rahul's bedroom.
Jayaben warns Rahul that the wind may scatter his documents.
Jayaben gathers the papers and returns them to the bedside table.
Jayaben leaves the room while continuing to mutter.

scenes.name: SC 10 · INT./EXT. RAHUL'S LIVING AREA & BALCONY · DAY
scenes.summary: Tea on the balcony; Rahul lifts his Aadhaar card, smiles, and the film ends on credits.

shots.action: Rahul comes out of his bedroom and looks around the living area.
Rahul picks up a cup of tea from the dining table.
Rahul walks toward the balcony with the tea.
Rahul stands on the balcony and sips his tea.
Rahul raises his hand and reveals the Aadhaar card.
Rahul smiles after seeing the Aadhaar card.
Fade out to facts, news and information, followed by the Crav Studios credit, title card and final credits.
